hyps.why: Without the direct 0->3 path, the conv on edge 4 becomes more important.
With no direct path, a conv on edge 5 contributes more.
Replacing a conv_1x1 with conv_3x3 gives a smaller gain than replacing a weak op or none.
Edge 0 is useful only if node 1 reaches the output through a strong op.
Node 1 is largely a dead end when edge 4 is removed, so edge 0 matters less.
A skip gives a needed gradient path when other output edges are cut.
Node 2 feeds the output through a conv, so a conv into node 2 pays off.
Removing edge 5 costs less when a strong direct conv path already exists.
Edge 2 matters only if node 2 flows onward through a strong op.
Adding pooling over none is not a loss, while replacing a conv with pooling is.
